documents_expected.why: Round 10 guidelines: eligibility, insurance, budget rules, attachments, reporting, timeline

eligibility.rule: Community groups or not-for-profit NRM groups with a volunteer base
eligibility.quote: Community groups with a volunteer base. • Not-for-profit Natural Resource Management (NRM) groups with a community volunteer base.

eligibility.rule: Incorporated, or auspiced by a group that administers the grant
eligibility.quote: Community groups must be incorporated or sponsored (under an auspicing arrangement) by another group or organisation that will administer their grant funding

eligibility.rule: Waterways or riparian zones in the Swan Canning Catchment
eligibility.quote: Projects must be in the Swan Canning Catchment or other catchments that feed into the Swan and Canning rivers.

eligibility.rule: One-year projects of $3,000–$10,000 (ex GST), run 1 July 2027 to 30 June 2028
eligibility.quote: In 2027-28 between $3,000 and $10,000 (ex GST) is available for one-year projects.
alt_quotes: One-year projects will be implemented from 1 July 2027 to 30 June 2028.

eligibility.rule: At most 10% of the grant on non-on-ground costs; no staff wages
eligibility.quote: A maximum of 10 percent of the total grant may be used toward non-on ground works including project administration and management costs
alt_quotes: Funds for staffing, wages or salary will not be considered.

eligibility.rule: Insurance (own, sponsor's or DBCA volunteer programme) and a signed Job Safety Analysis
eligibility.quote: All applicants must have adequate insurance and a signed JSA or equivalent for the project.

documents.item: Letter of support from each landowner or manager, with maintenance commitment
documents.quote: A letter of support for the project from the land owner(s) or land manager(s) including maintenance commitments and any covenants on the project site.
Map(s) of the project site clearly showing the location, North arrow and extent of the project.
Timeline for the project identifying when major activities will occur.

documents.item: Budget (template), with other cash and in-kind contributions
documents.quote: Budget clearly detailing what the grant will pay for.

documents.item: Sponsor's details and agreement, if auspiced
documents.quote: Applicants with a sponsor (auspicor) will need to provide the sponsoring organisation's details and evidence of their agreement to receive and administer the grant funding.

documents.item: ATO Statement by a supplier, if no ABN
documents.quote: ATO Statement by a supplier form (if applicable).

documents.item: Contractor ABN and quotes, if paying contractors
documents.quote: Paid contractors undertaking works must provide an ABN and quotation for works proposed.

alt_quotes: Applications close 11 December 2026 (No late applications will be accepted)

effort.step: Send insurance certificates, permits and other supporting information
effort.quote: Any additional or supporting information due* Applicants notified of outcome and negotiations for grant agreements commence 22 January 2027

effort.step: Negotiate the project agreement with DBCA
effort.quote: Negotiations and project development will be required between the applicant and DBCA before finalisation of the project agreement.

co_finance_required.quote: Demonstrate financial or in-kind contributions (this includes volunteer time) to the project.

after_award.quote: A completed report is to be submitted by the grant recipient at the end of each financial year of the project

notes: Round 10 has $100,000 in all. Contributions, including volunteer time valued at set rates, raise priority but aren't required. Photo points before works and photos every six months. The timeline table runs two rows together, so 22 January 2027 is read as the date for supporting information and March 2027 for outcomes; check the PDF if this matters. Projects on private land must show a public benefit.
